about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a full-stack engineer (B.Sc. Trakya, 2024; M.Sc. ongoing) building ReHeal, an early-stage digital health product: a React Native patient app, a Next.js clinic dashboard, and a SUT/SGK rule engine for pharmacies. Before that I interned at Jotform, Sixfab, and Parentwiser, and spent a short stretch at Elmali Tech shipping Next.js apps. I also work with ML when the problem needs it (BERTurk, XAI, ADS-B), but the day-to-day is TypeScript, Next.js, Expo, Supabase, Node. Open to full-stack roles.

projects.title: ReHeal
projects.description: Early-stage digital health product: a React Native patient app, a Next.js clinic dashboard, and a SUT/SGK pharmacy rule engine (Pharmaguard AI) for prescription compliance, Gemini-assisted medical PDF processing, QR onboarding, lab-report OCR, medication adherence, and Supabase Auth, Realtime, and Storage.

projects.title: Algoviz
projects.description: Interactive CS and AI simulation lab with 23 modules covering distributed systems (Raft, LRU Cache) and modern ML (Self-Attention, CNN, Decision Trees), plus 3D Three.js / WebGL loss landscapes.

projects.title: Ultimarket — Ultra-Light POS & Invoice Assistant
projects.description: Ultra-light POS, store credit (veresiye), and invoice assistant for low-spec shop PCs. Keyboard/barcode-first checkout (F2/F3/F4 shortcuts, USB/HID scanner), Prisma/Postgres ledger, and NVIDIA NIM vision for supplier invoice OCR with cost-increase alerts.

projects.title: Crisis XAI
projects.description: Crisis-time message classification with explainable AI (SHAP, LIME). BERTurk/PyTorch model, hybrid NER/Regex location extraction, evaluated on 11,268 samples with 5-fold CV (92.26% ± 0.81 F1). FastAPI backend and Next.js interface.

projects.title: DropSpot
projects.description: Limited stock product drops and waitlist platform; built with Next.js 16, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, dynamic priority scoring engine, and Docker Compose.

experience.description: Building a digital health startup across a React Native patient app, a Next.js clinic platform, and PharmaGuard AI. Working with Expo, Supabase, PostgreSQL RLS, Gemini Vision, and TypeScript rule engines.
Volunteer contributor and mentor for university projects. Helped migrate cPanel/MySQL systems to Supabase PostgreSQL with RLS and supported the team with Git and Agile practices.
Worked on production React and Next.js applications, including Digiroom. Contributed to SSR, dynamic routing, Supabase RLS, Firebase Cloud Functions, and e-commerce and booking synchronization.
Designed a micro-blogging platform using Vue.js and Flask. Managed CI/CD pipelines.
Built an internal notification center using React.js and Redux. Led a team of 3 interns.
Migrated the company’s website from WordPress to React.js. Contributed to a React Native mobile application for local kids' events.

education.description: Relevant coursework: Machine Learning, Text Mining, Cognitive Technologies, Scientific Ethics. Projects include a BERTurk crisis-tweet classifier with hybrid NER/Regex location extraction (11,268 samples; 95.75% accuracy), a CrowdStrike/Microsoft crisis analysis, and an ADS-B flight anomaly detector using Isolation Forest, SHAP, FastAPI and Next.js.
Graduation Project: AI-Powered Career Recommendation System, built with Kariyer.net scraping, TF-IDF, KNN and Django in a 6-person team.
